title: Scalar extension intertwines the exact open projection map and the scalar tensor maps.
statement: For arbitrary commutative rings A and B, a ring homomorphism φ:A→B and an open immersion j:U→X, use the canonical comparisons of [lem-coef-etale-open-comparison-data] and [lem-coef-etale-hom-thick-locus]. For every P in D(U_et,A) and T in D(X_et,A), γ_B(F_U P,F_X T);(q_P^(-1) tensor id);t_X(j_! P,T) = j_!((id tensor r_T^(-1));t_U(P,j^* T));q_(P tensor j^* T)^(-1);F_X(γ_A(P,T)). No boundedness, constructibility, flat coefficient-map or quasi-compact-open hypotheses are imposed.

proof.text: Regard the normalized scalar tensor isomorphisms t as natural isomorphisms of curried bifunctors, using their two naturality laws. Form the natural exact restriction tensor isomorphism by precomposing the existing mixed exact/left-derived tensor isomorphism with the inverse exact/left-derived comparison in its second argument.

The inverse q of the chosen open/scalar left-adjoint comparison is the iterated inverse mate of the sectionwise restriction-of-scalars square. Apply iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv_symm and unit_mateEquiv_symm. This proves the unit hypothesis for q inverse and r hom in the projection-map mate theorem. A generic naturality calculation identifies canonicalGammaExact with the projectionMap for the exact restriction tensorator; no monoidal transport or K-flat assertion for extension by zero is used.

Use the scalar/restriction tensor square of lem-coef-etale-open-scalar-restriction-tensor as the tensor hypothesis of projectionMap_mate, with both right functors equal to exact restriction, the coefficient functors equal to scalar extension, and tensor maps t inverse. The conclusion is q inverse followed by F_X(gamma_A) and t_X inverse equals j_!(t_U inverse), j_!(id tensor r), gamma_B and q inverse tensor id.

Precompose this identity with j_!((id tensor r inverse);t_U) and postcompose with t_X. Functoriality and the inverse identities for r and t cancel the auxiliary factors. Reverse the resulting equality to obtain precisely the stated mixed projection square.

theorem etaleOpenMixedTensorScalar
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {U X : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] :
    ∀ (P : DerivedCategoryModule A U) (T : DerivedCategoryModule A X),
    canonicalGammaExact (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) j
        ((scalarExtension φ U).obj P) ((scalarExtension φ X).obj T) ≫
        ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) X).map
          ((openScalarExtension φ j).inv.app P)).app ((scalarExtension φ X).obj T) ≫
        (etaleHomTensorComparison X φ ((derivedExtension (A := A) j).obj P) T).hom =
      (derivedExtension (A := B) j).map
          (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) U).obj ((scalarExtension φ U).obj P)).map
              ((openScalarRestriction φ j).inv.app T) ≫
            (etaleHomTensorComparison U φ P ((derivedRestriction j).obj T)).hom) ≫
        (openScalarExtension φ j).inv.app
          (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) U).obj P).obj ((derivedRestriction j).obj T)) ≫
        (scalarExtension φ X).map (canonicalGammaExact (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j P T)
